g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-404 Wrap labeler for round containers (built in house) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: BEARING HOUSING 201 x 2 (1:1), SECTION, 304 Ø75 BAR
2 x 6001-2RS back to back, DIN 472 Ø28 each end; spigot Ø40 g6 x 10 into the plate (H8);

g.text: Ø12 h6: O-RING PULLEY + 18T PULLEY, FLAT 0.5 FOR SET SCREWS
Ø12 h6 IN THE HOUSING BEARINGS, DIN 471 GROOVES

svg.text: PINCH LEVER 203 (2:1), 304 6 + Ø8 SHAFT + UHMW ROLLER Ø20
Ø8 H8 pivot on a shoulder screw; Ø5.2 eye for the 20 N spring (P1-458) to the plate pin;
roller centre 4.8 below the pivot; Ø8 shaft 140 long pressed in, UHMW roller Ø20 x 120 free on it, DIN 471 Ø8
4 bends 90° up, IR 1.5; corners closed by the flanges; 3 x Ø4.5 tabs to standoffs on the plate (H12)
VIEW R: DRIVE ROLLER P1-425 (1:2), BOUGHT TO THIS DRAWING
Urethane 70A 6 thick on a 304 tube, ground; run-out 0.05 TIR; drive end (-x) 45 long with 3 x 0.5 flat;
both rollers matched to ±0.05 on Ø so the container does not walk
turn spigot Ø40 g6, bore Ø28 H7 + 2 ring grooves, drill 3 x Ø5.5
turn Ø30 h8 face 180, Ø12 h6 journals, knurl, mill 2 flats
laser lever, press shaft, turn roller Ø20 x 120 bore Ø8.2
